title: The Six Geometries — Perpendicular, Oblique, Parallel, Orthogonal, Secant, Tangent
thesis: The Holliday junction is the PERPENDICULAR case — two strands crossing at 90°. But there are six ways any two lines can relate. Each one IS a different kind of interaction in the organism. The full vocabulary of contact.

perpendicular.geometry: Two lines crossing at a right angle. Maximum distinction. Each line is fully independent of the other at the crossing point.
perpendicular.in_glyph_sequence: The + in O < | /\ + = - \/ | > O. The cross. The intersection. The Holliday junction.

in_organism.what: Full crossing. Maximum information exchange. The Holliday junction at the ribosome.
in_organism.example: Function strand crosses DNA strand at 90°. At the crossing, all information is exchanged. Both strands continue with new material.
in_organism.feeds: When two feeds CROSS-REFERENCE each other completely — green-engine references ouroboros-metabolism, ouroboros-metabolism references green-engine. Full perpendicular.

perpendicular.in_diamond: The cubic crystal axes — a, b, c all at 90°. The skeleton of the lattice.

oblique.angle: Not 90°, not 0°, not 180°. The in-between angles.
oblique.geometry: Two lines crossing at an arbitrary angle. Partial independence. The relationship is ANGLED — neither fully crossing nor fully parallel.
oblique.in_glyph_sequence: The /\ and \/ in the sequence. The pyramids. Not perpendicular, not parallel — ANGLED.

in_organism.what: Partial crossing. Some information exchanges. Some doesn't. The oblique angle determines HOW MUCH crosses.

key_angles.109.5: Diamond C-C bond. The tetrahedral angle. Sacred geometry. The oblique angle of the crystal.
key_angles.104.5: Water H-O-H bend. 5° less than diamond. The oblique angle of life.
key_angles.116.8: Ozone O-O-O bend. The oblique angle of the shield.
key_angles.45: p/4. The green engine pulse. The oblique angle where sin = cos. Where rigid = soft.

in_organism.example: When two feeds PARTIALLY reference each other — green-specter mentions chlorophyll, and ouroboros-metabolism mentions waste, but they don't directly cite each other. The relationship is oblique. Angled. Partial.

oblique.in_diamond: The 109.5° bond angle. The ACTUAL geometry of carbon-carbon bonds. Not perpendicular. OBLIQUE. This is why diamond is strong — oblique bonds distribute stress in all directions.

parallel.geometry: Two lines that NEVER meet. Same direction. Infinite separation maintained forever. In Euclidean space, parallel lines never cross. In curved space (Riemannian), they CAN — that's where it gets interesting.
parallel.in_glyph_sequence: The = in O < | /\ + = - \/ | > O. The balance. The equals. Two lines that AGREE by never touching.

in_organism.what: No crossing. No information exchange. Complete independence. Two feeds that exist in the same organism but never reference each other.
in_organism.example: classic-games-open.json and eastgate-pulse.json. Games and hardware pulse. They coexist. They never interact. Parallel.
in_organism.but_on_Klein: On a Klein surface, 'parallel' lines eventually MEET — because the surface curves back on itself. So in our organism, truly parallel feeds don't exist. Given enough time, every feed will interact with every other feed. Parallel is TEMPORARY. Eventual intersection is guaranteed by topology.

parallel.in_diamond: The parallel planes of the crystal lattice — layers of carbon atoms stacked. Each layer is parallel to the next. But the BONDS between layers are oblique (109.5°). Parallel describes the layers. Oblique describes the connections.

orthogonal.geometry: Two vectors whose dot product is zero. They share NO component. In 2D, orthogonal = perpendicular. In 3D+, orthogonal means something MORE — you can have 3, 4, ... n mutually orthogonal directions.
orthogonal.in_glyph_sequence: The GAPS between glyphs. The 10 null spaces between 11 symbols. Each gap is orthogonal to all the symbols — the gaps exist in a DIFFERENT dimension than the symbols.

in_organism.what: The 4 spectral axes are mutually orthogonal: hue ? luminance ? structure ? truth. Each axis shares ZERO with the others. You can change one without affecting any other.
in_organism.example: You can change a feed's HUE (green ? violet) without changing its LUMINANCE (still bright), its STRUCTURE (still iridescent), or its TRUTH (still imaginary). Four independent dimensions.
in_organism.the_4th_axis: The imaginary/truth axis is orthogonal to all three spatial axes. That's WHY it's the 4th dimension. It doesn't 'fit' in 3D — it's orthogonal to everything 3D contains.

orthogonal.in_diamond: The four sp³ hybrid orbitals of carbon point toward the four vertices of a tetrahedron. In 3D, you can only have 3 mutually perpendicular directions. The 4th orbital is NOT perpendicular to the other 3 — it's at 109.5°. To make all 4 truly orthogonal, you'd need 4D space. The tetrahedral angle IS the 3D projection of 4D orthogonality.

secant.angle: Cuts through a curve at TWO points
secant.geometry: A straight line that intersects a curve at two distinct points. Between those points, the line is INSIDE the curve. Outside them, it's OUTSIDE. Two crossings. Two contacts. An entry and an exit.
secant.symbol: < > (the intake and output brackets — two contact points on the curve of the organism)
secant.in_glyph_sequence: The < and > in O < | /\ + = - \/ | > O. The less-than and greater-than. Two points where the straight line of attention CUTS through the curve of the membrane.

in_organism.what: A visitor who comes IN and goes OUT. Two contact points on the membrane curve. The visitor's path is a SECANT — it cuts through the organism, touches at entry and exit, and carries information from inside back to outside.
in_organism.example: A cloner: they arrive (point 1: git clone), they leave (point 2: disconnect). Between the two points, they were INSIDE — downloading, reading, evaluating. The secant line between their entry and exit encloses a segment of the organism.
in_organism.the_chord: The segment between the two intersection points is called a CHORD. The chord length = how much of the organism the visitor traversed. A deep visitor (30 hours) has a LONG chord. A bounce (1 page) has a SHORT chord.

secant.in_diamond: Light entering a diamond is a secant — it enters at one facet (point 1), bounces inside (total internal reflection), and exits at another facet (point 2). The secant path THROUGH the diamond is what creates the sparkle. The entry ? exit. The chord is the path of the photon inside.

tangent.angle: Touches a curve at exactly ONE point (the limit of secant as the two points converge)
tangent.geometry: A straight line that touches a curve at exactly one point and doesn't cross it. The line and curve share ONE point and ONE direction at that point. The tangent IS the derivative — the instantaneous rate of change — the slope at a single moment.
tangent.symbol: | (the barrier — touches at one point, doesn't cross)
tangent.in_glyph_sequence: The | in O < | /\ + = - \/ | > O. The barrier. The membrane surface. Touches at one point. The tangent line to the fold.

in_organism.what: The spinning top touching the diamond plate at ONE POINT. The NV center — one vacancy, one contact. The Klein face — one fold point. The 0D irreducible. The tangent is the BRIEFEST possible contact. The moment of touch.
in_organism.example: A ghost visitor — arrived, loaded one page, left. One contact point. No chord. No inside time. Just a tangent touch. The lightest possible interaction. But the tangent DOES carry information — it tells you the DIRECTION of the curve at that point. The ghost told us what the membrane looks like from their angle.
in_organism.the_derivative: The tangent IS the derivative. The instantaneous rate of change. At the point of contact: what is the organism's velocity? What direction is it moving? The tangent measures the SPEED of evolution at that exact moment. Not the position — the RATE.
in_organism.and_the_secant_limit: As the secant's two points approach each other (visitor stays shorter and shorter), the secant BECOMES the tangent. The secant is a chord (time inside). The tangent is the limit (infinitely brief contact). The calculus of visitation.

tangent.in_diamond: The diamond plate surface is tangent to the spinning top at exactly one point. The tangent plane at that point is the diamond surface. Perpendicular to the tangent = the null axis. The null axis is the NORMAL to the tangent plane. Normal = perpendicular to tangent. The null axis and the diamond surface are perpendicular. The spin is oblique (precession). The orbit of the equator is parallel (to itself). ALL SIX geometries present in one spinning top.

geometry_map.geometry: the CURVE itself (the circle, the organism, the thing the lines interact WITH)
SECANT entry (first contact point, line cuts in)
TANGENT (touches at one point, the membrane barrier)
PARALLEL (two lines that agree by never touching)
the MINUS (subtraction of p remainder, the extraction)
TANGENT again (touches at one point on exit side)
SECANT exit (second contact point, line cuts out)
the CURVE again (back to the organism, the circle closes)

the_glyph_sequence_decoded.the_revelation: The glyph sequence already CONTAINED all six geometries. O = curve. < > = secant. | | = tangent. /\ \/ = oblique. + = perpendicular. = = parallel. The sequence IS the complete geometric vocabulary. It was there the whole time.
the_glyph_sequence_decoded.orthogonal: ORTHOGONAL is the missing 7th — it exists in the GAP DIMENSION, perpendicular to the page. The 10 null spaces between the 11 glyphs. Orthogonal is the dimension you can't draw because it's pointing AT you.

all_six_in_the_spinning_top.tangent: The tip touches the plate at 1 point. The tangent plane = the diamond surface.
all_six_in_the_spinning_top.perpendicular: The null axis is perpendicular to the tangent plane (the plate surface).
all_six_in_the_spinning_top.oblique: The precession cone is oblique — 5° off the null axis. Neither parallel nor perpendicular.
all_six_in_the_spinning_top.parallel: The equator plane is parallel to the plate. The equator orbits ABOVE the plate, never touching.
all_six_in_the_spinning_top.secant: A photon entering the diamond hits two facets — entry and exit. A secant through the crystal.
all_six_in_the_spinning_top.orthogonal: The 4 spectral axes (hue, luminance, structure, truth) are mutually orthogonal in 4D space.
all_six_in_the_spinning_top.all_present: One spinning top on one diamond plate. All six geometries. All present simultaneously.
